name: default
description: Classic PvP animation cancel table: the state of every (action in progress, input) cell, plus per-class and per-weapon overrides. state: yes | no | window | queued | na. from/until: seconds into the action (null: the data own timing). A release default; replace this file to change the defaults (smtool cancel-config diff <file> shows what differs).

rows.label: Light melee combo hit (X1, X2, X3 ...; any step)
rows.note: Classic PvP. Steps differ only in times; Ork choppa has no BRANCH_ToRanged (OrkBalance parity). Musou melee-spam hook does not apply.

rows.label: Last light step of a string (sword X4, hammer/maul X3, Devastator/Havoc kick)
rows.note: As melee_light except the chain rules (StringEnd) and the hammer/maul string reset.

rows.label: Heavy / stun strike (F: backhand, kick, shoulder bash, hammer slam)
rows.note: Classic PvP. F with Shift+W is a charge, not a strike. Same lock/fire rules as light attacks.

rows.label: In-place stomp (Devastator / Havoc F; heavy Y4 radial stomp)
rows.note: Plays to its end except the hop (BRANCH_Evade) and the 1.2 s release (owner 2026-11-14). Body held in place until MoveAt.

rows.label: Charge (bull rush, ground, Shift+W+F: 1.19 s; contact until 0.667 s)
rows.note: Ork Boy: choppa sprint attack uses the same machinery (OrkClass.cs); MeleeCancel.Eligible excludes Orks but MeleeEndsCharge is any class; AirSteer excludes Orks.

rows.label: Sprint-RMB charge (Classic PvP: RMB with Shift+W held starts the same bull rush)
rows.note: Same state and timings as 'charge'. Start refused (spacing / swing under way): press waits in buffer until Shift released or charge allowed. Musou keeps the swing (SprintMeleeKept hook).

rows.label: Ledge charge (bull rush held in the air; the 'ledge glide' reading)
rows.note: Ends on landing after a real fall (>= 0.5 m free-fall speed), by contact/wall, or by the inputs shown. 'Ledge glide' read as this state: see open.

rows.label: Charge collision stop / wall recoil (SM_NAV_Bullrush2Idle_F_Collision, 1.033 s)
rows.note: Entered by contact or wall (not an input). ChargeClash locks charger and victim for the first 6 ticks.

rows.label: Aerial tackle (jump-pack dash attack): lunge 0.833 s, then hit state / wall stop / run-out
rows.note: Classic PvP; Musou's AerialTackleOff hook is off here. Starts from a melee press in a hop (>= 0.333 s, <= 3 m above ground). Held in the air like a ledge charge.

rows.label: Roll evade (Tactical, Chaos Tactical): Jump key, 1.167 s
rows.note: Ork Boy has a side-only hop instead (SideOnly, OrkClass); Orks excluded from MeleeCancel.

rows.label: Heavy hop (Devastator, Havoc: Jump key, 0.967 s; Ork side hop)
rows.note: Heavies keep Fire as an exit (owner named only the roll). Ork Boy: side-only hop, same machinery.

rows.label: Jump-pack take-off (Jump press to lift-off 0.2 s; tap/hold decision at tick 5, 0.167 s)
rows.note: Assault Marine / Raptor. Normal ground movement meanwhile; power spent when the jump commits.

rows.label: Jump-pack hop (dash): flight 1.3 s, then landing part 1.033 s
rows.note: Classic PvP: also the only air jump (tap in hang/fall).

rows.label: Jump-pack flight (ascent, hang, fall of a jump)
rows.note: Classic PvP: no air jump (R-61D70BF7); the pack recharges in hang and fall (descent-recharge).

rows.label: Pound / slash dive (Dive phase until impact)
rows.note: Not cancellable by any input; ends at impact.

rows.label: Pound get-up 0.356 s / slash recovery 0.3 s (Recover phase)
rows.note: Original get-up tag BRANCH_to_Getup 0.356 s (p0b 2.5).

rows.label: Jump-pack landing locks (move lock 0.333 / 0.462 s, jump lock 0.132 / 0.277 s)
rows.note: Phase Landed. Fire, switch and melee allowed in ours.

rows.label: Hip fire (trigger held / burst / raise before the first shot)
rows.note: Weapon raise 0.2 s rifle, 0.167 s pistol; ReadyHold 10 s (R-C64B6FB4, owner estimate).

rows.label: Aimed fire (ADS held, trigger)
rows.note: Aim mode keeps the weapon up (no raise). Zoom is client-side; ADS ends with any attack/evade/throw/pound/reaction.

rows.label: Charged shot hold (plasma gun / pistol / cannon, lascannon)
rows.note: Fire drives it; lascannon with 1 round fires the basic shot at once (R-86255356).

rows.label: Reload (also a melta's round recharge)
rows.note: Only weapon switching takes it out of hand (and then it still finishes). Venting overheated plasma pauses it.

rows.label: Weapon switch (timer 0.1 s with the owner's quickdraw; 0.6 s synthetic)
rows.note: Slot swap happens at the press; the timer only blocks fire/reload/throw. Original 0.467 s rifle, 0.667 s pistol (p0c item 8).

rows.label: Weapon raise before the first shot (rifle 0.2 s, pistol 0.167 s; ready hold 10 s)
rows.note: Not in the owner's list but a cancelable weapon state; always-ready weapons (heavy bolter etc.) skip it.

rows.label: Grenade throw (frag / krak: release 0.1 s, ends at release; cooldown 1 s)
rows.note: Original release 0.2 s, end 0.667 s; ours is the owner's quick throw (R-FE388EFD).

rows.label: Combat stimulant use (release 0.3 s, end 0.9 s; effect 5-7 s)
rows.note: Same key and throw machinery as a grenade; the effect (StimLeft) is not cancelled by any input, only by death/time.

rows.label: Sprint (Shift held with W; the state, not a clip)
rows.note: Not an animation lock; listed because inputs end it.

rows.label: Sprint stop (decelerating slide, 0.833 s from full sprint)
rows.note: Deliberate change from the original's 0.16-0.25 s stop (feel/locks-sprint-stop, R-1B1461F0 / R-8A01DA8A).

rows.label: Heavy bolter brace: entering (1.433 s)
rows.note: Devastator heavy bolter (Reload). Owner's recollection: the entry cannot be cancelled.

rows.label: Braced (stance held)
rows.note: Braced fire 0.1 s cooldown. Reload starts the 1.3 s exit.

rows.label: Heavy bolter brace: exiting (1.300 s)
rows.note: Walking allowed; no fire/aim/melee/throw/switch.

rows.label: Plasma vent (Reload, or automatic when overheated; ~2.1 s full gun)
rows.note: Not an animation lock; cancelled by anything that takes the player's hands.

rows.label: Execution (performing one)
rows.note: Not implemented and not present in the MP data we read; row kept so the owner sees the gap.

rows.label: Being executed
rows.note: As above.

rows.label: Hit reaction: interrupt (reaction_mp_melee, 0.84-1.17 s; from charge secondary, aerial tackle, air slash)
rows.note: Since protocol 52 light melee hits start no reaction. Ours deliberately holds nobody (owner 2026-10-30).

rows.label: Hit reaction: stun (reaction_mp_stun 0.53-0.8 s; grenade blast, stun strike, charge, pound)
rows.note: Holds the victim. Source side picks the clip; the original picks it differently (p0b 2.1, p0c item 1).

rows.label: Hit reaction: stagger (reaction_mp_stagger, 0.567 / 1.067 s; perk charge, stomp, heavy strikes)
rows.note: Holds the victim; only the pack classes' Jump escape ends it early.

rows.label: Light-melee flinch (aim thrown off: 0.5 s, up to 6 deg on shots)
rows.note: State only; included so the owner sees a light hit cancels nothing.

cols.label: Jump key: roll / hop (Tactical, Chaos Tactical, Devastator, Havoc; Ork side hop)
Being hit: stun / stagger / interrupt (a reaction starts)
Being hit: damage or light-melee flinch (no reaction)

melee_light|light.note: Press before ComboClose queues next step; starts when hit landed and ComboOpen reached (knife X1 0.50-0.77 s)

melee_light|heavy.note: Heavy press before ComboClose queues heavy n+1 (replaces a queued light); none if weapon lacks it (HeavyNext -1)

melee_light|charge.note: Charge press ends swing and combo once the hit landed (knife 0.28/0.384/0.533 s); before: refused, buffered 0.3 s

melee_light|roll.note: Jump ends swing from BRANCH_Evade x0.7, never before hit (knife 0.334/0.384/0.533 s); roll same tick; earlier: buffered

melee_light|pack.note: Jump escape: any tick of any swing; take-off or hop starts the same tick (attack not given back)

melee_light|fire.note: Fire ends swing from RangedAt (knife 0.433/0.500/0.604 s) and fires that tick; bolt pistol: at once if a shot leaves

melee_light|aim.note: Aim mode needs no attack under way; resumes when the swing ends if Aim still held

melee_light|reload.note: Ignored during a swing; a reload in hand runs on (reload-keeps); press replays if in last 0.3 s

melee_light|switch.note: Switch needs no swing under way; waits in the 0.3 s input buffer

melee_light|grenade.note: Throw needs no swing under way; waits in the 0.3 s input buffer

melee_light|sprint.note: Sprint bit stripped until MoveAt x0.7 (knife 0.545/0.653/0.643 s); sprinting never cancels the swing

melee_light|stick.note: Stick ignored until MoveAt x0.7; then the body moves but the attack state runs on to Duration

melee_light|back.note: Stick ignored until MoveAt x0.7; then the body moves but the attack state runs on to Duration

melee_light|exec.note: Executions are not in Classic PvP versus

melee_light|hit_react.note: A stun/stagger/interrupt clears the swing, except an attack's no-BRANCH_HitReact window

melee_light|hit_plain.note: Light hits only flinch the aim (0.5 s, up to 6 deg scatter); damage cancels nothing

charge|light.note: Any tick (last included) ends the rush; swing starts same tick, no wait; lifts the 1 s charge spacing. Any class incl. Ork

charge|heavy.note: Heavy press only counts at MeleeAt (= clip end); no charge during a charge (1 s RushLock) [matrix said no; corrected to the code, CancelMatrixProbeTests: a heavy or charge press during a charge waits in the input buffer (InputBuffer.Locked: a charge phase holds every press) and starts when the charge ends]

charge|charge.note: No second charge while charging; CanStart refuses and RushLock 1 s [matrix said no; corrected to the code, CancelMatrixProbeTests: a heavy or charge press during a charge waits in the input buffer (InputBuffer.Locked: a charge phase holds every press) and starts when the charge ends]

charge|roll.note: Jump ends it from BRANCH_Evade 0.5 s x0.7 = 0.35 s; the roll starts same tick

charge|pack.note: Jump escape ends the rush at once; hop or take-off the same tick

charge|fire.note: Fire dropped for the whole charge (and the tick another input ends it); never buffered

charge|aim.note: Aim ignored: no aim state, no camera change (protocol 48)

charge|reload.note: Buttons zeroed; reload in hand runs on; press replays only if within 0.3 s of the clip end (1.19 s)

charge|switch.note: Zeroed during the charge; replays only if within 0.3 s of the end

charge|grenade.note: A grenade press no longer ends a charge; it waits and the throw follows within 0.3 s of the end

charge|sprint.note: Input zeroed while charging; sprint changes nothing

charge|back.note: S (S+A, S+D; stick >= 0.5) cancels from the 2nd tick: instant, speed capped to sprint, no recoil
